title: Deliciu V2 Pink Lemonade 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Deliciu V2 Pink Lemonade Nic Salt delivers a refreshing and vibrant vape experience with its classic Pink Lemonade flavour. This sweet and tangy blend combines the zesty notes of freshly squeezed lemons with pink, plump summer berries, creating a balanced, refreshing e-liquid that’s perfect for an all-day vape. With each inhale, you’ll experience a burst of citrus followed by a smooth and sweet exhale. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts are ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. The enhanced formulation ensures smoothness and rich flavour with every puff. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nicotine salts provide rapid nicotine relief and a smoother throat hit compared to traditional freebase e-liquids. The Deliciu V2 range from Vaporesso revamps the original line up of bestselling flavours with a heightened focus on quality and flavour precision, delivering improved profiles based on customer feedback. Designed for compatibility with a wide range of low-powered MTL devices, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts deliver exceptionally authentic flavours and consistent, enjoyable vaping. The perfect companion for any refillable e-cigarette or starter vape device , making vaping effortless and enjoyable.
